references.text: The beginning of Jotham's fable where the trees seek a king, providing context for the vine's invitation
The vine's response to the invitation to rule over the trees, in which it declines the offer
The continuation of the fable where the trees finally turn to the thornbush, which accepts to rule
The vine as a symbol of Israel, planted by God and growing to cover the land
Isaiah's parable of the vineyard representing Israel and Judah
Jesus describes himself as the true vine, with his disciples as the branches
